import json
from pathlib import Path
day='2026-11-14'
root=Path('/Users/mac/.cursor/projects/Users-mac-Desktop-CHcode/agent-transcripts')
# today's dirs by mtime listing earlier
ids=['7ea1eff5-f59c-4a3e-b2ca-80b75775f29b','556c4a71-f3cf-450a-bfa3-6e9434760e8b','4f9141ac-5982-44ca-a969-cd75829812e6','9846b4a2-f7d1-4a68-adaa-e9ba0ce43644','74589f1f-9849-4ca7-ac2d-5629aff4e4d0','6bddbe3d-e4e3-4bdb-a0b4-f249766e7687']
for tid in ids:
  p=root/tid/f'{tid}.jsonl'
  if not p.exists():
    print('missing', tid); continue
  print('\n====', tid, 'size', p.stat().st_size)
  user_bits=[]; asst_bits=[]
  for i,line in enumerate(open(p)):
    try: o=json.loads(line)
    except: continue
    role=o.get('role') or o.get('type') or ''
    # cursor transcript formats vary
    msg=o.get('message') or o
    content=msg.get('content') if isinstance(msg, dict) else None
    text=''
    if isinstance(content, list):
      for c in content:
        if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get('type') in ('text','input_text','output_text'):
          text += c.get('text','')
        elif isinstance(c, str):
          text += c
    elif isinstance(content, str):
      text=content
    elif isinstance(o.get('text'), str):
      text=o['text']
    text=text.strip()
    if not text: continue
    # keep short summary
    head=text.replace('\n',' ')[:160]
    if role in ('user','human') or o.get('type')=='user':
      user_bits.append(head)
    elif role in ('assistant','') or 'assistant' in str(role):
      asst_bits.append(head)
  print('USER samples:')
  for u in user_bits[:8]:
    print(' U:', u)
  print('ASST samples:')
  for a in asst_bits[:10]:
    print(' A:', a)
  print('counts user',len(user_bits),'asst',len(asst_bits))
PY
